children: Flex Ltd. (FLEX) filed a Form 8K - Acquisition or Disposition of Assets - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on October 14, 2026.

As previously disclosed, on September 3, 2026, the Company, ACS Acquisitions, Inc., a Delaware corporation and wholly owned subsidiary of the Company (the "Purchaser"), EPC Power Corp., a Delaware corporation ("EPC Power"), and Charge Parent, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the "Seller"), entered into a Stock Purchase Agreement (the "Purchase Agreement"), pursuant to which the Purchaser agreed to acquire all of the equity interests of EPC Power from the Seller (such transaction, the "Transaction"). On October 14, 2026, the Company completed the Transaction. EPC Power is now a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company and part of the Company's Cloud and Power Infrastructure business, which, as previously announced, the Company plans to separate into an independent publicly traded company, Axiom Solutions International, Inc. ("Axiom") in the first quarter of 2027 (the "Spin-Off"). Pursuant to the Purchase Agreement, the purchase price paid upon the completion of the Transaction was $4.4 billion in cash, subject to customary adjustments as set forth in the Purchase Agreement (the "Consideration"). The Purchase Agreement contains a "locked box" mechanism in which the enterprise value of EPC Power has been fixed as of June 30, 2026 (the "Locked Box Date"). EPC Power and the Seller have agreed to customary protections against leakage of value from EPC Power between the Locked Box Date and the date of the closing of the Transaction, subject to customary exceptions for permitted leakage.
The Company funded the Consideration with borrowings under the Credit Facility (as defined below), borrowings under the Bridge Credit Facility and cash on hand.

The foregoing description of the Purchase Agreement and the Transaction does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the description in the Company's Current Report on Form 8-K filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC") on September 4, 2026, which description is incorporated herein by reference, and the full text of the Purchase Agreement, a copy of which was filed by the Company as Exhibit 2.1 to the Company's Current Report on Form 8-K filed with the SEC on September 4, 2026, and which is incorporated herein by reference.

As previously disclosed, on October 2, 2026, the Company and Axiom entered into a Series A Convertible Preferred Stock Investment Agreement (the "Preferred Investment Agreement") with GC Venture XIII (ASI), L.P. and the other investors party thereto (collectively, the "Preferred Investors"), pursuant to which the Preferred Investors agreed to purchase 200,000 shares of Axiom's Series A Convertible Preferred Stock, par value $0.0001 per share (the "Convertible Preferred Stock"), in a private placement at a per share purchase price of $10,000 and an aggregate purchase price of $2.0 billion (the "Preferred Investment"). The closing of the Preferred Investment remains subject to the satisfaction or waiver of certain customary closing conditions, including, among other things, the expiration or termination of the applicable waiting period (and any extension thereof) under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976, as amended, and the receipt of certain other required regulatory approval. Axiom expects to use the net proceeds from the Preferred Investment to, among other things, repay borrowings incurred by the Company in connection with the Transaction.

The foregoing description of the Preferred Investment and the Preferred Investment Agreement does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the description in the Company's Current Report on Form 8-K filed with the SEC on October 5, 2026, which

description is incorporated herein by reference, and the full text of the Preferred Investment Agreement, a copy of which was filed by the Company as Exhibit 10.1 to the Company's Current Report on Form 8-K filed with the SEC on October 5, 2026, and which is incorporated herein by reference.
